'''''Star Wars: Dark Droids: D-Squad''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries published by [[Marvel Comics]] that served as a spinoff of the comic event ''[[Star Wars: Dark Droids]]''. The series was written by [[Marc Guggenheim]], illustrated by [[Salva Espín]], [[David Messina]] and [[Israel Silva]], with the [[Dark Droids: D-Squad 1|first issue]] published on [[September 20]], [[2023]].
